text: The LORD rules! He is robed in majesty — the LORD is robed, clothed with strength. Yes, he set the world firmly in place; [1] it won’t be shaken.
Your throne is set firm for a very long time. You are eternal!
LORD, the floods have raised up — the floods have raised up their voices; the floods raise up a roar!
But mightier than the sound of much water, mightier than the sea’s waves, mighty on high is the LORD!
Your laws are so faithful. Holiness decorates your house, LORD, for all time.
